description: This file declares classes, functions, and data structures related to the JIT tracer in PyTorch, including TracingState management, argument stashing, node creation, and input/output handling for tracing operations.

classes.name: TracingState
classes.description: Manages the state during tracing, including the computation graph, warning modes, and environment stack.

classes.name: ArgumentStash
classes.description: Stores temporary argument data such as IntArrayRef and Value pointers during tracing.

methods.name: getTracerStateWarnMode
methods.description: Returns the atomic boolean reference controlling warning mode during tracing.

methods.name: getTracingState
methods.description: Retrieves the current tracing state, or nullptr if tracing is disabled.

methods.name: setTracingState
methods.description: Sets the current tracing state.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Issues a warning if tracing is enabled and warn mode is active.

methods.name: setWarn
methods.description: Sets the warning function callback.

methods.name: recordSourceLocation
methods.description: Records source location information for a node.

methods.name: setRecordSourceLocation
methods.description: Sets the function to record source location.

methods.name: pythonCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves the current Python call stack.

methods.name: setPythonCallstack
methods.description: Sets the function to retrieve the Python call stack.

methods.name: setValueTrace
methods.description: Associates an IR node with an output variable.

methods.name: delValueTrace
methods.description: Removes the trace association for a variable.

methods.name: pauseTracing
methods.description: Pauses the tracing process temporarily.

methods.name: getValueTrace
methods.description: Retrieves the trace value associated with a variable.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs tracing on a function with given inputs and options.

methods.name: abandon
methods.description: Abandons the current tracing process.

methods.name: addInputs
methods.description: Adds various types of inputs to a node during tracing.

methods.name: addOutput
methods.description: Adds output values to a node during tracing.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output value for a node.

methods.name: ensureUniqueIfOutOfPlaced
methods.description: Ensures tensor is uniquely owned if used out-of-place.

methods.name: getSizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: getNumelOf
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in a tensor.
